armpb.prose: The Pit Bull is the tier-2 pop-up gauss cannon: 680 metal and 14000 energy, 2800 health, a 675-damage shot every 1.6 seconds (422 a second) at range 730. It hunkers when idle, more than doubling its effective health, and it cloaks for 16 energy a second so air scouts do not see it; it kills tier-1 units and heavy tier-2 that come within its reach and is the bread-and-butter tier-2 fortification. Skirmishers and artillery that out-range it beat it, so pair it with radar, a jammer and a Rattlesnake (armamb); it cannot fire over a Fortification Wall (armfort).

armpeep.name: Blink
armpeep.gloss: 52-metal air scout, speed 375, sight 865; sees the enemy base and army; unarmed, dies to fighters
armpeep.prose: The Blink is the air scout: 52 metal, 89 health, speed 375, sight 865 and 1140 radar, no weapon. A pass over the enemy base shows its factories, economy and army in a few seconds, and that is worth far more than its cost every few minutes of a game; it also draws anti-air fire away from a bombing run. Fighters and any anti-air kill it. Build one from the aircraft plant as soon as it stands, and another whenever the picture is stale.

armpincer.name: Pincer
armpincer.air: 17 dps against aircraft (22% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armpincer.gloss: tier-1 amphibious tank; drives the sea floor to arrive from the water; 1340 health, cannon at 305
armpincer.prose: The Pincer is a 200-metal amphibious tank (1340 health, speed 63) with a 116-damage cannon every 1.5 seconds at range 305 and 180 sonar. It drives along the sea floor and climbs like a bot, so it reaches an expansion from the water or over ground tanks cannot cross, and its fast shell hits raiders better than a Stout's; it loses a straight fight to true tanks and to turrets. It takes only a fifth of EMP damage. Build it on maps with water between you and the enemy.

armplat.name: Seaplane Platform
armplat.gloss: tier-1 seaplane platform under water, 1450 metal; makes the construction seaplane, Sabre, Tsunami, Puffin, Cyclone, Horizon
armplat.prose: The Seaplane Platform sits on the sea floor and rises to work: 1450 metal and 5000 energy, 2000 health, 300 build power, 750 radar and 600 sonar, making the Construction Seaplane (armcsa), Sabre, Tsunami, Puffin, Cyclone and Horizon. It is the air factory for a sea map, offered only where the builder reaches deep water. Seaplanes land on and rise from the water, so a base with no land can still fly scouts, bombers and fighters.

armpnix.name: Blizzard
armpnix.air: 190 dps against aircraft, its full damage
armpnix.gloss: tier-2 strategic bomber, five 266-damage bombs; four take a fusion in a pass; dies to fighters and flak
armpnix.prose: The Blizzard is the tier-2 bomber: 230 metal, 1130 health, speed 258, a run of five 266-damage bombs. It is for buildings: four of them kill a Fusion Reactor (armfus) in one pass, and it hurts a group of units if the run is laid across their path. It is cheaper and weaker than the Hailstorm (corhurc); fighters and flak kill it, so scout and escort.

armpship.name: Ellysaw
armpship.air: 62 dps against aircraft (53% of its ground damage)
armpship.gloss: tier-1 assault frigate, plasma at 470, 2150 health; beats destroyers in numbers, no anti-submarine weapon
armpship.prose: The Ellysaw is the frigate between corvette and destroyer: 380 metal, 2150 health, speed 81, two light plasma cannons doing 117 damage a second at range 470. In numbers it beats destroyers by range and speed, fought broadside so both turrets fire. It has nothing against submarines and nothing against aircraft.

armpt.name: Skater
armpt.air: 71 dps against aircraft, its full damage
armpt.gloss: tier-1 stealthy patrol boat, speed 93, light laser and anti-air, sonar; scouts and harasses builders, loses to any warship
armpt.prose: The Skater is a fast patrol boat: 150 metal, 780 health, speed 93, a light laser at range 300, an anti-air missile at 760, 400 sonar and 750 sight, invisible to radar. It scouts the sea, harasses early structures and blocks expanding constructors, and it is the early fleet's anti-air; against any real warship it is hopeless. Keep it as scout and support.

armpw.name: Pawn
armpw.air: 20 dps against aircraft (22% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armpw.gloss: fast cheap raider bot; kills builders, extractors and lone turrets, loses to line bots and riot tanks
armpw.prose: The Pawn is the tier-1 raider: 54 metal, 370 health, speed 87, and 90 damage a second from rapid plasma at range 180. It is for what cannot shoot back: constructors, extractors, radar, and turrets still under construction, and a pair standing on an approach stops the enemy's lone raider. In an equal-metal fight head on it beats only the Grunt (corak); it loses to the Thug (corthud) badly, to the Brute (corraid), to a Sentry (armllt) or Guard (corllt), and to the Pounder (corlevlr) worst of all, so a Pawn ball sent at a defended line is metal thrown away. Its weapon does 2 damage to aircraft, which is nothing. Spread Pawns out: in a loose formation they do much better against Maces and plasma than packed.

armrad.name: Radar Tower
armrad.gloss: 60-metal radar tower, 2100 radar, 680 sight; shows what moves within range as dots; jammed, blocked by hills
armrad.prose: The Radar Tower shows every enemy unit within 2100 as a radar dot, for 60 metal and 630 energy, 180 health, with 680 sight of its own. It is the early warning for raids and air and the eyes for anything that fires further than it sees; the record shows most games with the enemy base found late, and a radar on an approach fixes that cheaply. Hills block it, a jammer hides units from it and cloaked units do not show. An Osprey (armhvytrans) can carry one forward.

armraz.name: Razorback
armraz.air: 200 dps against aircraft (19% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armraz.gloss: 3800-metal fast battle mech; rapid lasers at 475 shred swarms and heavies alike; 450 energy a volley
armraz.prose: The Razorback is a fast tier-3 mech: 3800 metal, 13300 health, speed 69, twin rapid laser cannons doing about 1050 damage a second at range 475 for 450 energy a volley. It kills swarms and heavy units up close and can hit gunships; it loses to anything with more range (Sharpshooter, Starlight, Pulsar) and has modest health for its class. It is the gantry's answer when the enemy has an army rather than a fortress.

armrecl.name: Grim Reaper
armrecl.gloss: stealthy resurrection submarine; repairs, reclaims and resurrects wrecks under water; unarmed
armrecl.prose: The Grim Reaper is the naval support sub: 240 metal, 420 health, speed 66, submerged and unseen without sonar, with 150 build power to repair, reclaim and resurrect wrecks. Resurrection costs half the unit's energy cost and no metal, so one behind a sea fight turns the wrecks into a fleet. It has no weapon.

armrectr.name: Lazarus
armrectr.gloss: 200-build-power repair and resurrection bot; cannot build or fight, follows the army, hides from radar
armrectr.prose: The Lazarus is a 130-metal support bot with 200 build power, two and a half times a constructor's, that can repair, reclaim and resurrect but cannot build anything. Resurrecting a wreck brings back the whole unit for energy only, so a Lazarus or two behind a fight turns the enemy's dead into your army. It has 220 health, no weapon and is invisible to radar, so it lives only where nothing can see it; keep it behind the line and pull it back when the line breaks. Its energy use while working is what limits it in a stall.

armrl.name: Nettle
armrl.gloss: 80-metal light anti-air tower, missiles at 765; stops scouts and light aircraft, nothing against ground; needs radar
armrl.prose: The Nettle is the light anti-air tower: 80 metal and 900 energy, 330 health, missiles at range 765 that do full damage to aircraft and nothing worth counting to anything else. A few around a base or an extractor line stop Blinks (armpeep), Banshees (armkam) and lone bombers; its rate of fire is low, so a swarm or a heavy gunship gets through unless several stand together, and it fires further than it sees, so radar coverage makes it work. Build it only after enemy aircraft or an aircraft plant have been seen.

armrock.name: Rocketeer
armrock.air: 41 dps against aircraft, its full damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range
armrock.gloss: rocket bot that outranges light turrets (475 vs 430); slow single rockets, loses to anything that closes
armrock.prose: The Rocketeer fires one 157-damage rocket every 3.8 seconds at range 475: 120 metal, 720 health, speed 51. Its range is more than a Sentry (armllt) or Guard (corllt) has, so a group held at range kills light turrets and the extractors behind them; it is worth building for that. Against anything that moves it is poor, because the rocket is slow and unguided and the engine barely leads a moving target: in equal-metal duels it lost to the Thug (corthud), Incisor (corgator), Blitz (armflash) and Brute (corraid), and it is inside the reach of a Twin Guard (corhllt, 490) and heavy laser tower (620). Give it a screen of Pawns (armpw) or Maces (armham) in front, and never let it fight raiders alone. It cannot hit aircraft.

armroy.name: Corsair
armroy.gloss: tier-1 destroyer, plasma at 700 and seeker torpedoes; outranges every tier-1 ship and torpedo launcher, slow to turn
armroy.prose: The Corsair is the tier-1 destroyer: 880 metal, 3700 health, speed 67, a 235-damage plasma cannon every 1.6 seconds at range 700 plus torpedoes and 375 sonar. It outranges every tier-1 ship and the static torpedo launchers, kills submarines, and is the fleet's anchor; lighter ships overrun it because it turns slowly, so escort it with corvettes and a repair unit. Its wreck is worth protecting.

armsaber.name: Sabre
armsaber.gloss: tier-1 seaplane gunship, 67 dps blasters at 425; surprise raids on ships and naval bases; dies to anti-air
armsaber.prose: The Sabre is a light seaplane gunship: 210 metal, 1010 health, speed 157, twin blasters doing 67 damage a second at range 425 for 15 energy a shot, against land and sea units. A group makes fast surprise attacks on ships and naval buildings and gets through a light missile turret; naval anti-air, fighters and anything heavier kill it. It has 1010 health and 15 energy a shot, so a stalled economy grounds it as surely as a fighter does.

armsam.name: Whistler
armsam.air: 48 dps against aircraft, its full damage
armsam.gloss: tier-1 missile truck, 550 range against ground and 700 against air; low damage, outranges light towers
armsam.prose: The Whistler is a light missile truck: 150 metal, 820 health, speed 55, a ground missile at range 550 doing 86 damage every 3.3 seconds (26 a second) and a separate homing anti-air missile at 700. It outranges the light towers and the commander and keeps chipping from a distance, and it is the vehicle plant's only anti-air; its damage is low and it loses any close fight. Keep it at range behind Stouts (armstump) with a fight order rather than attack, so it does not close.

armsb.name: Tsunami
armsb.air: 143 dps against aircraft, its full damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range
armsb.gloss: tier-1 seaplane bomber, five 200-damage bombs; hits slow ships and static naval targets; loses to fighters and flak
armsb.prose: The Tsunami is a seaplane bomber: 240 metal, 1170 health, speed 267, a run of five 200-damage bombs every 7 seconds. It hits slow ships, naval buildings and grouped units, and it makes surprise runs on a land base from the sea; tier-1 anti-air alone struggles to stop it, fighters and flak do. Scout first, send fighters ahead, and pair with a radar plane for targets.

armscab.name: Umbrella
armscab.gloss: mobile all-terrain anti-nuke; stockpiles interceptors to protect an army from nuclear missiles; unarmed
armscab.prose: The Umbrella is a 1150-metal mobile anti-nuke on all-terrain legs, 870 health, speed 51. It stockpiles interceptor missiles (150 metal and 6500 energy each, 90 seconds a missile) and shoots down nuclear missiles aimed within its cover, which is shorter than the fixed Citadel's (armamd). It is built to give an army or an expansion cover a fixed anti-nuke cannot reach; it has no other weapon and dies to anything.

armsd.name: Tracer
armsd.gloss: 710-metal intrusion detector, pings moving cloaked and stealthy units within 2000 for 125 energy a second; guards the anti-nuke
armsd.prose: The Tracer detects moving cloaked and radar-invisible units within 2000 by their vibration, terrain notwithstanding, for 710 metal and 7100 energy, 2650 health, 125 energy a second. It shows them as pings with a sound, not as targets, so units must be ordered onto them by hand; a standing cloaked unit is not seen. It is what protects a Citadel (armamd) from a Ghost's (armspy) EMP and a base from Gremlins (armgremlin). Only the tier-2 constructors build it.

armseap.name: Puffin
armseap.air: 5 dps against aircraft (4% of its ground damage)
armseap.gloss: tier-1 torpedo gunship seaplane; circles ships dropping homing torpedoes; kills subs, weak to anti-air
armseap.prose: The Puffin is a torpedo gunship seaplane: 290 metal, 1300 health, speed 210, a 342-damage homing torpedo every 3 seconds at range 600, 535 sonar. It circles ships and submarines dropping torpedoes and works in narrow water where torpedo bombers miss, so it kills submarines without risking ships. Naval anti-air and fighters kill it.

armseer.name: Prophet
armseer.gloss: tier-2 radar vehicle, 2300 radar and 900 sight; lets artillery and skirmishers use their range; unarmed
armseer.prose: The Prophet is a 125-metal radar vehicle: 2300 radar range, 900 sight, 980 health, no weapon. It shows the enemy to units that fire further than they see, Mausers (armmart), Starlights (armmanni), Whistlers (armsam) and plasma batteries; one behind an army turns range into hits. It dies to any raider that reaches it.

armsehak.name: Horizon
armsehak.gloss: tier-1 radar and sonar seaplane, 2250 radar and 900 sonar at speed 338; scouts the sea; unarmed
armsehak.prose: The Horizon is an unarmed radar and sonar seaplane: 125 metal, 580 health, speed 338, 2250 radar and 900 sonar. It scouts the sea and shows a fleet what is in the air, on the water and under it. Fighters kill it.

armserp.name: Serpent
armserp.air: 206 dps against aircraft, its full damage
armserp.gloss: tier-2 battle submarine, 825-damage torpedoes at 800; the naval sniper, kills heavy ships; loses to Barracudas
armserp.prose: The Serpent is the battle submarine: 1800 metal, 3550 health, speed 45, an 825-damage tracking torpedo every 8 seconds at range 800 (less against other subs), submerged and unseen without sonar. It kills heavy ships and tier-3 amphibious units from beyond their reach, the naval Sharpshooter; submarine killers like the Barracuda (armsubk) and Predator (corshark), advanced torpedo launchers and anything up close beat it. Never the whole fleet.

armsfig.name: Cyclone
armsfig.gloss: tier-1 seaplane fighter, air-to-air missiles at 710; escorts bombers and ships, submerges to escape
armsfig.prose: The Cyclone is the seaplane fighter: 90 metal, 220 health, speed 311, anti-air missiles at range 710 that do nothing to ground. It escorts seaplane bombers and a fleet against enemy aircraft and can submerge under water to escape fighters. Against anything on the ground it is useless.

armsh.name: Seeker
armsh.air: 12 dps against aircraft (19% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armsh.gloss: 85-metal fast hovercraft raider, laser at 230; lands behind the line and swarms; dies to light towers
armsh.prose: The Seeker is a cheap fast hovercraft: 85 metal, 290 health, speed 114, a 36-damage laser every 0.6 seconds at range 230. It crosses water and land alike, so a swarm lands on a beach behind the enemy's line and raids the expansion there, and surrounded units take extra damage from it. A Sentry (armllt) or Guard (corllt) kills it, and so does any line unit; it is for where the defences are not.

armshltx.name: Experimental Gantry
armshltx.gloss: tier-3 gantry, 7900 metal, 1800 build power; makes the Titan, Razorback, Marauder, Vanguard, Lunkhead, Thor
armshltx.prose: The Experimental Gantry is the tier-3 factory: 7900 metal and 58000 energy, 16000 health, 1800 build power, making the Titan (armbanth), Razorback, Marauder, Vanguard, Lunkhead and Thor. An advanced constructor builds it. It is a late-game decision: the gantry and its first unit are a tier-2 economy's whole output for minutes, and each unit it makes is a single point of failure to EMP, bombers or a D-gun.

armshltxuw.name: Experimental Gantry
armshltxuw.gloss: tier-3 gantry under water, 7900 metal; makes the amphibious experimentals: Titan, Marauder, Turtle, Lunkhead
armshltxuw.prose: The underwater Experimental Gantry is the sea version of the gantry (armshltx): 7900 metal and 58000 energy, 16000 health, 1800 build power, built on the sea floor by the Advanced Construction Sub (armacsub), making the Titan, Marauder, Turtle and Lunkhead. It is offered only where the builder reaches deep water. Its units arrive from the sea floor, which is the reason to build it rather than the land gantry.

armsilo.name: Armageddon
armsilo.gloss: 8100-metal nuclear silo, stockpiles 12500-damage missiles at 125000 energy each; erases a base or an army; stopped by anti-nukes
armsilo.prose: The Armageddon is the nuclear silo: 8100 metal and 90000 energy, 5900 health, stockpiling nuclear missiles that take 120 seconds and 125000 energy each, up to ten, and turn a base or an army inside the blast to ash. An anti-nuke covering the target stops it, unless several are fired at once or a Ghost (armspy) has stunned the anti-nuke first; aim at what no anti-nuke covers. It is a decision of a whole tier-2 economy.

armsjam.name: Bermuda
armsjam.gloss: tier-2 radar jammer ship, hides units within 980 from enemy radar for 90 energy a second; unarmed
armsjam.prose: The Bermuda is the fleet's jammer: 310 metal, 1350 health, speed 45, everything within 980 of it hidden from enemy radar for 90 energy a second, no weapon. It escorts Longbows (armmship) to the shore for a surprise bombardment and moves a fleet round a flank unseen; line of sight still sees the ships. It has no gun of its own and dies to anything that finds it, so it stays inside the fleet.

armsnipe.name: Sharpshooter
armsnipe.gloss: cloaked sniper: 2500 damage at 900 every 10 s for 500 energy; 580 health, dies when found
armsnipe.prose: The Sharpshooter fires a 2500-damage instant shot at range 900 every ten seconds for 500 energy: 680 metal, 580 health, speed 33. Its range is more than any tower short of the plasma batteries and it one-shots most tier-1 and light tier-2 units, so a few behind a line delete the enemy's best unit each salvo; it cloaks when standing (75 energy a second, 200 moving), which is how it survives. It has almost no health, a slow rate of fire that swarms overwhelm, and needs vision or radar to hit anything; a Pinpointer (armtarg) makes radar shots accurate. The simulator could not judge it (no cloak model), so its worth against a tower line is untested here.

armsolar.name: Solar Collector
armsolar.gloss: 20 energy a second for 155 metal and no energy to build; the safe generator from an empty store
armsolar.prose: The Solar Collector makes 20 energy a second for 155 metal and, unusually, no energy at all to build, with 340 health and 50 energy storage. That is why it is the first generator when the store is empty or a lab is about to draw 80 a second: it never stalls the builder. At 7.75 metal per energy a second it is dearer than wind on a windy map (Quicksilver averages 12) and cheaper than wind where the wind is weak; strong players build one solar and then wind. It closes when hit and loses its output while closed.

armspid.name: Webber
armspid.gloss: all-terrain EMP spider; stuns at 280 without damage, hides from radar, reclaims; kills nothing on its own
armspid.prose: The Webber is an all-terrain tier-2 spider with a paralysing beam at range 280: 250 metal, 1110 health, speed 72. Its beam does no damage; it stuns whatever it hits so something else can kill it, or so the Webber itself can reclaim the stunned unit, which is its trick against expensive targets. It is invisible to radar and climbs cliffs, so it ambushes from where the enemy is not looking; on its own it kills nothing and dies to any line unit. Build it beside Recluses (armsptk) or to disable a heavy unit for the D-gun.

armsptk.name: Recluse
armsptk.gloss: all-terrain rocket spider, three rockets at 575; climbs cliffs to reach turrets; poor against fast targets
armsptk.prose: The Recluse is an all-terrain bot with three-rocket salvos (3 x 200 damage every 3.75 seconds, area 90) at range 575: 400 metal, 1390 health, speed 47. It climbs slopes nothing else can, so it reaches turrets and extractors from above them, and it kills slow units and buildings well; against fast movers its rockets miss, and it loses to a line that catches it in the open. Pair it with the Webber (armspid) on cliffs, and use it where the ground, not the metal, decides.

armspy.name: Ghost
armspy.gloss: cloaked, radar-invisible spy; sees for artillery and self-destructs into an EMP burst; no weapon
armspy.prose: The Ghost is a 135-metal spy bot that is both cloaked and invisible to radar (15 energy a second standing, 40 moving), with 300 health and no weapon. It walks into the enemy base to spot for artillery and long-range guns, and it can self-destruct in a 360-wide EMP burst that stuns everything nearby, which is how a single spy switches off an anti-nuke or a turret cluster for twenty seconds. A Tracer (armsd) or Nemesis (corsd) detects it; anything that sees it kills it. It can also reclaim walls and, slowly, enemy buildings, but must uncloak to do so.

armstil.name: Stiletto
armstil.gloss: tier-2 EMP bomber hidden from radar; its bombs stun a line of units for 20 s, no damage
armstil.prose: The Stiletto is the EMP bomber: 460 metal, 1880 health, speed 300, invisible to radar, a run of three paralysing bombs that stun land units, ships and hovercraft for twenty seconds without damaging them. A stunned army or turret line is killed by whatever follows, so time the run with an attack; it stuns friends too, so mind the approach path, and its bombs fall before it enters most anti-air ranges. Queue a move away from the anti-air after the drop.

armstump.name: Stout
armstump.air: 15 dps against aircraft (19% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armstump.gloss: tier-1 medium tank, 1800 health, plasma at 350; the vehicle line unit, loses to Maces and Pounders
armstump.prose: The Stout is the armoured core of a tier-1 vehicle army: 225 metal, 1800 health, speed 75, a 97-damage shot every 1.2 seconds at range 350. It has the health per metal to lead a push and the speed to arrive together on open ground, and packs of them raid a base on their own. In equal-metal duels head on it lost to the Mace (armham) and badly to the Pounder (corlevlr), so it is not the answer to bots; it is the answer to raiders and light defences, with Whistlers (armsam) or Shellshockers (armart) behind it. The commander's D-gun, pop-up flame turrets and mines on a blind push are what kill Stout packs.

armsub.name: Eel
armsub.air: 86 dps against aircraft, its full damage
armsub.gloss: tier-1 submarine, unguided torpedoes at 500; invisible without sonar, kills underwater extractors and unguarded fleets
armsub.prose: The Eel is the tier-1 submarine: 440 metal, 840 health, speed 66, a 342-damage torpedo every 4 seconds at range 500, invisible to radar and to anything without sonar. One or two sneaked into a careless enemy's water kill underwater extractors and ships without anti-submarine weapons; anything with sonar and torpedoes kills it, since it has little health. Sonar and other submarines see it, and a destroyer's torpedoes end it quickly.

armsubk.name: Barracuda
armsubk.air: 175 dps against aircraft, its full damage
armsubk.gloss: tier-2 fast submarine, homing torpedoes at 400; the submarine killer, hunts battle subs; a few in every tier-2 navy
armsubk.prose: The Barracuda is the submarine killer: 950 metal, 2350 health, speed 81, a 350-damage homing torpedo every 2 seconds at range 400, 525 sonar, faster and more agile than other submarines with wider firing angles. It hunts enemy submarines, the tier-2 battle subs above all, which otherwise kill an unguarded fleet. A few belong in every tier-2 navy.

armsy.name: Shipyard
armsy.gloss: tier-1 shipyard on water, 450 metal; makes the construction ship, Skater, Dolphin, Ellysaw, Corsair, Eel, Grim Reaper
armsy.prose: The Shipyard is the tier-1 naval factory, built only on water: 450 metal and 950 energy, 4100 health, 150 build power, making the Construction Ship (armcs), Skater, Dolphin, Ellysaw, Corsair, Eel and Grim Reaper. It is offered only where the builder can reach water deep enough. On a land map there is no reason to build it.

armtarg.name: Pinpointer
armtarg.gloss: 810-metal targeting facility, halves radar-dot wobble for the whole team, 100 energy a second; three is plenty
armtarg.prose: The Pinpointer halves the wobble of radar dots for the whole team, for 810 metal and 7200 energy, 2100 health, and 100 energy a second. It is what lets Sharpshooters (armsnipe), artillery, the Pulsar (armanni) and the plasma batteries hit what radar shows without sight; a second and third stack with diminishing returns (75 and 87.5 percent), and three is plenty. Only the tier-2 constructors build it.

armthor.name: Thor
armthor.gloss: 9000-metal EMP mech: lightning at 540, EMP lasers and a manual EMP missile; stuns armies, slow, hates bombers
armthor.prose: The Thor is a 9000-metal tier-3 mech (56000 health, speed 54) built around paralysis: a heavy lightning cannon at range 540, twin EMP lasers at 350, and an EMP missile fired by hand (the D key, stockpile of two) at range 1050. It stuns whole armies so the rest of yours kills them, and it is the front-line unit for a close fight. It has no paralyse resistance of its own, is slow, and bombers kill it; its weapons need energy.

armthund.name: Stormbringer
armthund.air: 92 dps against aircraft, its full damage
armthund.gloss: tier-1 bomber, five 110-damage bombs in a line; kills buildings and slow groups; loses to fighters and anti-air
armthund.prose: The Stormbringer is the tier-1 bomber: 150 metal, 670 health, speed 250, a run of five 110-damage bombs dropped in a line. It kills buildings, slow units and packed groups, and a few of them level an undefended expansion; fighters and any anti-air kill it. Scout the target and its anti-air first, send Falcons (armfig) ahead, and line the run up with the target's layout; it is slightly weaker than the Whirlwind (corshad).

armtide.name: Tidal Generator
armtide.gloss: 90-metal tidal generator on water; steady output set by the map's tide
armtide.prose: The Tidal Generator makes a steady amount of energy set by the map's tidal strength, for 90 metal and 200 energy, 400 health, built on water. Where the tide is good it is cheap steady energy for a sea base; on a land map it is not offered. Its output is fixed, unlike wind's.

armtl.name: Harpoon
armtl.air: 187 dps against aircraft, its full damage
armtl.gloss: 170-metal offshore torpedo launcher, 187 dps at 500 against ships and subs; nothing against land or air
armtl.prose: The Harpoon is the tier-1 torpedo launcher built on water: 170 metal and 1500 energy, 1300 health, a 280-damage unguided torpedo every 1.5 seconds at range 500 with its own 400 sonar. It kills ships and submarines that come near and is the cheap defence of a sea base; it cannot hit land, air or hovercraft, and destroyers out-range it. It is offered only where the builder finds water, and it is the first defence a shipyard gets.

armuwadves.name: Hardened Energy Storage
armuwadves.gloss: tier-2 hardened storage, 40000 energy for 830 metal, 11700 health; the bank for stockpile weapons and gantries
armuwadves.prose: The Hardened Energy Storage adds 40000 energy storage for 830 metal and 10000 energy, with 11700 health. It is the bank that a nuclear silo, a Pulsar (armanni) or a long-range cannon draws on, and it lets a big economy ride a stall; the tier-2 constructors build it on land or water. Its health makes it the storage that survives a raid, so the bank is still there when the enemy leaves.

armuwadvms.name: Hardened Metal Storage
armuwadvms.gloss: tier-2 hardened storage, 10000 metal for 750 metal, 10300 health
armuwadvms.prose: The Hardened Metal Storage adds 10000 metal storage for 750 metal and 11500 energy, with 10300 health. It is for a tier-2 economy that banks for gantry units and long-range guns; the tier-2 constructors build it on land or water. It is a late buy: at tier 1 a full metal store means a second lab, not a bigger store.

armuwageo.name: Advanced Geothermal Powerplant
armuwageo.gloss: tier-2 geothermal on an underwater vent, 1250 energy a second for 1600 metal
armuwageo.prose: The underwater Advanced Geothermal Powerplant is the Advanced Geothermal Powerplant (armageo) for a vent under water: 1250 energy a second for 1600 metal and 27000 energy, 3600 health, 12000 energy storage, with the same base-levelling explosion. Only a builder that works under water places it. It is the most metal-efficient energy a sea base can build, and the most dangerous to stand near.

armuwes.name: Naval Energy Storage
armuwes.gloss: 6000 energy storage built under water for 170 metal
armuwes.prose: The Naval Energy Storage is the Energy Storage (armestor) built on the sea floor: 6000 energy storage for 170 metal and 1700 energy, 1890 health. It explodes when destroyed. Only a builder that works under water places it.

armuwfus.name: Naval Fusion Reactor
armuwfus.gloss: tier-2 fusion on water, 1200 energy a second for 5200 metal; hides energy under the sea
armuwfus.prose: The Naval Fusion Reactor is the water-built fusion: 1200 energy a second for 5200 metal and 33500 energy, 5600 health, 2500 energy storage. It is the energy of a sea base and a way to keep energy out of a land raid's reach; it explodes when destroyed. Only the Advanced Construction Sub (armacsub) builds it.

armuwgeo.name: Offshore Geothermal Powerplant
armuwgeo.gloss: 300 energy a second on an underwater steam vent, 560 metal
armuwgeo.prose: The Offshore Geothermal Powerplant is the Geothermal Powerplant (armgeo) for a vent under water: 300 energy a second for 560 metal and 13000 energy, 1940 health. Only a builder that works under water places it. It gives a sea base the same steady energy as the land plant, and explodes the same way when killed.

armuwmme.name: Naval Advanced Metal Extractor
armuwmme.gloss: tier-2 extractor upgrade for an underwater spot, 620 metal, four times the yield
armuwmme.prose: The Naval Advanced Metal Extractor is the Advanced Metal Extractor (armmoho) for a spot under water: 620 metal and 7700 energy, 2800 health, four times the spot's yield, 20 energy a second upkeep, 600 metal storage. The Advanced Construction Sub (armacsub) builds it on a claimed underwater spot. Like the land upgrade it repays its metal in about 100 seconds and draws 20 energy a second.

armuwmmm.name: Naval Advanced Energy Converter
armuwmmm.gloss: the tier-2 converter on water, 600 energy a second into 10.3 metal for 380 metal
armuwmmm.prose: The Naval Advanced Energy Converter is the Advanced Energy Converter (armmmkr) built on water: 600 energy a second into 10.3 metal a second for 380 metal and 21000 energy, 445 health. It is for a sea base's energy surplus, and it chains explosions when clustered. Only the Advanced Construction Sub (armacsub) builds it, and only the tier-2 sea economy has the surplus to feed it.

armuwms.name: Naval Metal Storage
armuwms.gloss: 3000 metal storage built under water for 330 metal
armuwms.prose: The Naval Metal Storage is the Metal Storage (armmstor) built on the sea floor: 3000 metal storage for 330 metal and 570 energy, 3600 health. Only a builder that works under water places it. It explodes when destroyed, like the land store.

armvader.name: Tumbleweed
armvader.gloss: amphibious crawling bomb; walks to a target and explodes, far harder if self-destructed; spread them out
armvader.prose: The Tumbleweed is a 65-metal rolling bomb with 445 health, speed 84, that crosses water. It carries no gun; it walks or rolls into a group of units or a building and explodes, and the blast on a self-destruct order is much larger than when it is shot. A swarm must be spread out, since one going off sets off the rest. It is for packed tanks, turret clusters and things that cannot shoot it before it arrives.

armvang.name: Vanguard
armvang.gloss: all-terrain 1450-range plasma mech; outranges every tower, slow (33); dies to raiders that reach it
armvang.prose: The Vanguard is a 3300-metal all-terrain artillery mech: 8500 health, speed 33, a 1265-damage plasma shell every 8 seconds at range 1450, which is more than any turret including the plasma batteries. It climbs where tanks cannot and shells a fortified line from a place the line cannot answer; only the Cortex Catapult (corcat) outranges it. It is slow and has no close defence, so fast raiders kill it unless it is guarded.

armveil.name: Veil
armveil.gloss: 125-metal tier-2 jammer tower, hides everything within 760 from radar for 125 energy a second
armveil.prose: The Veil is the tier-2 jammer tower: 125 metal and 19000 energy, 830 health, hiding everything within 760 from enemy radar for 125 energy a second. It hides a whole base or a massed army from long-range weapons that target by radar; line of sight still sees through it. The tier-2 constructors and the Consul (armconsul) build it.

armvp.name: Vehicle Plant
armvp.gloss: tier-1 vehicle plant, 590 metal; makes the constructor vehicle, Rover, Blitz, Stout, Shellshocker, Janus, Whistler, Pincer, Beaver, Groundhog
armvp.prose: The Vehicle Plant is the tier-1 vehicle factory: 590 metal and 1550 energy, 3000 health, 150 build power, ten units: Construction Vehicle (armcv), Beaver, Groundhog, Rover, Blitz, Pincer, Stout, Shellshocker, Janus and Whistler. Vehicles are faster on flat ground, tougher and dearer than bots and climb worse, and the plant is where tier-1 artillery comes from; strong players favour it on large open maps. It costs more than the bot lab and draws more energy while building.

armvulc.name: Ragnarok
armvulc.gloss: 70000-metal rapid-fire long-range cannon, 1625 damage every 0.6 s at 5750; ends games, the enemy's whole attention
armvulc.prose: The Ragnarok is the rapid-fire long-range cannon: 70000 metal and 830000 energy, 32000 health, a 1625-damage shell every 0.6 seconds at range 5750 for 15000 energy a shot. It is a whole late economy in one building and, running, it levels everything in range; it is also the first target of everything the enemy has. There is nothing in the harness that knows when it is the right buy.

armwar.name: Centurion
armwar.air: 30 dps against aircraft (16% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
armwar.gloss: tough anti-swarm bot; twin lasers shred Pawns and Grunts at 325; slow, loses to Pounders and stand-off
armwar.prose: The Centurion is the tier-1 riot bot: 270 metal, 1590 health, speed 45, two rapid lasers doing 183 damage a second at range 325 and, unusually for a laser, no energy cost per shot. It beats swarms of Pawns (armpw) and Grunts (corak) and in equal-metal duels won most tier-1 matchups outright; its bad matchup is the Pounder (corlevlr), and anything that stays at range 380 or more (a Mace, artillery, a heavy tower) shoots it without reply. It outranges the commander's laser by 25. Build it when the enemy fields raider swarms or when a line needs a tough unit that does not draw energy.

armwin.name: Wind Turbine
armwin.gloss: 40-metal wind generator; output follows the map's wind (the picture's economy line says this map's average); costs energy to build
armwin.prose: The Wind Turbine makes whatever the wind gives, up to 25 energy a second, for 40 metal and 175 energy, 196 health. On a windy map it is the cheapest energy there is (about 3 metal per energy a second at an average of 12) and the bulk of a tier-1 economy; where the wind is weak the Solar Collector (armsolar) is the better buy. It costs energy to build, so a first turbine from an empty store stalls, and its output swings minute to minute, which is what storage and a solar or two are for.

armyork.name: Shredder
armyork.gloss: tier-2 flak tank; wide-area flak at 775 kills groups of aircraft; nothing against ground
armyork.prose: The Shredder is the tier-2 flak vehicle: 450 metal, 2600 health, speed 70.5, rapid flak at range 775 whose wide bursts kill tier-1 and most tier-2 aircraft in groups. It has no ground weapon at all and needs the army for cover; flak's range is shorter than missile anti-air but far better against a formation. Build it only once enemy air has been seen.

armzeus.name: Welder
armzeus.gloss: tier-2 assault bot: 3500 health, lightning at 280 that arcs; loses to being kited; needs energy to fire
armzeus.prose: The Welder is the tough tier-2 bot: 350 metal, 3500 health, speed 48, a lightning gun at range 280 doing 129 damage a second that jumps between nearby targets. It holds a line and kills raiders and light bots that come into its short reach, and the simulated study puts it with the Hound (armfido) as Armada's tier-2 mix; on its own it loses, because 280 range at speed 48 gets shot on the way in by anything with reach, and a pure Welder army scored -0.6. It draws about 59 energy a second while firing, so a tier-2 bot army is an energy purchase; below about 150 energy a second spare it stops working.

coraak.name: Manticore
coraak.gloss: tier-2 heavy anti-air bot, missiles at 1300 and flak at 775; air only, walks under water
coraak.prose: The Manticore is the tier-2 mobile anti-air: 650 metal, 3200 health, speed 34.5, a missile launcher at range 1300 and a flak cannon at 775, both for aircraft only. It covers an army from the back against bombers and gunships and can walk under water, though not fire from there. Against ground it does nothing, so it is worth building only once the enemy has shown air.

coraap.name: Advanced Aircraft Plant
coraap.gloss: tier-2 aircraft plant, 2900 metal, 600 build power; makes the Nighthawk, Wasp, Hailstorm, Skyhook, Dragon and the rest
coraap.prose: The Advanced Aircraft Plant is the tier-2 air factory: 2900 metal and 28000 energy, 3900 health, 600 build power, 1000 radar, making the Advanced Construction Aircraft (coraca), Wasp, Hailstorm, Angler, Nighthawk, Condor, Skyhook and Dragon. It is the most energy-expensive factory to build and its units are the most energy-expensive to make; it pays when the enemy has no anti-air or when a fusion cluster or a slow army is the target. It makes the Condor (corawac) as well, whose radar finds targets for everything the plant makes.

coraca.name: Advanced Construction Aircraft
coraca.gloss: tier-2 constructor aircraft, 130 build power at speed 181; upgrades far extractors, builds fusion; fragile
coraca.prose: The Advanced Construction Aircraft is the flying tier-2 builder: 360 metal, 205 health, speed 181, 130 build power, no weapon. It reaches any extractor on the map to upgrade it and builds fusion, geothermal, advanced converters, heavy turrets and the gantry; its build power is lower than the land constructors', so use a pack. Fighters and any anti-air kill it.

corack.name: Advanced Construction Bot
corack.gloss: tier-2 constructor bot, 220 build power; the only builder of advanced extractors, fusion and tier-2 buildings
corack.prose: The Advanced Construction Bot is the builder tier 2 exists for: 470 metal, 1000 health, speed 33, 220 build power, no weapon. Advanced extractors (cormoho), fusion (corfus), the advanced converter, advanced radar, heavy turrets and the gantry are on its list and on no tier-1 builder's; the chain is constructor, advanced lab, this, then upgrades. Its first job is upgrading the safest extractors, about 70 seconds each with metal banked and minutes each without, so give it helpers or a bank. It dies to any raider that reaches it.

coracsub.name: Advanced Construction Sub
coracsub.gloss: tier-2 constructor submarine, 350 build power; upgrades underwater extractors, builds fusion and the underwater gantry
coracsub.prose: The Advanced Construction Sub is the submerged tier-2 builder: 700 metal, 1110 health, speed 65, 350 build power, no weapon, and it makes 30 energy. It upgrades underwater extractors, builds naval fusion, advanced converters, the advanced shipyard, sonar, pinpointer, torpedo launchers and the underwater Experimental Gantry (corgantuw). Guard it with the fleet and assist it with tier-1 constructors.

coracv.name: Advanced Construction Vehicle
coracv.gloss: tier-2 constructor vehicle, 310 build power; builds advanced extractors, fusion and tier-2 buildings; unarmed
coracv.prose: The Advanced Construction Vehicle is the vehicle line's tier-2 builder: 580 metal, 2150 health, speed 49.5, 310 build power, no weapon. Advanced extractors (cormoho), fusion (corfus), advanced converters, heavy turrets and the gantry are on its list and on no tier-1 builder's; it has the most build power of the tier-2 constructors but climbs poorly. Its first job is upgrading the safest extractors; it dies to any raider that reaches it.

coradvsol.name: Advanced Solar Collector
coradvsol.gloss: 80 energy a second for 370 metal, no weather; four solars in one footprint, as metal-efficient as fusion
coradvsol.prose: The Advanced Solar Collector makes a steady 80 energy a second for 370 metal and 4000 energy, 1200 health, 100 energy storage. At 4.6 metal per energy a second it is as cheap as a fusion reactor per unit of energy and needs no tier-2 builder, so it is the tier-1 way to a big, steady income where wind is poor; it is much dearer up front than solar or wind, and the energy to build it is the cost that bites at tier 1. It is the safest generator to leave unguarded, since nothing about it draws bombers the way a fusion does.

corafus.name: Advanced Fusion Reactor
corafus.gloss: 3000 energy a second for 9700 metal; the late-game energy for long-range guns and gantries; huge explosion
corafus.prose: The Advanced Fusion Reactor makes 3000 energy a second for 9700 metal and 48000 energy, with 9800 health and 9000 energy storage. It is what powers a Bulwark (cordoom), a long-range cannon or a gantry army late in a game, and it is the bomber's favourite target; its explosion levels everything near it, so it stands alone under anti-air. Only the tier-2 constructors build it.

corageo.name: Advanced Geothermal Powerplant
corageo.gloss: tier-2 geothermal, 1250 energy a second on a vent for 1500 metal; low health, devastating when it explodes
corageo.prose: The Advanced Geothermal Powerplant makes 1250 energy a second for 1500 metal and 27000 energy on a steam vent, with 4150 health and 12000 energy storage. It is the most metal-efficient energy in the game, and its explosion can take most of a base with it, so it goes on a vent the enemy cannot reach and away from everything else. Only the tier-2 constructors build it.

corah.name: Birdeater
corah.gloss: tier-1 anti-air hovercraft, missiles at 700; covers a hover force or a fleet against light aircraft; expensive
corah.prose: The Birdeater is a 250-metal anti-air hovercraft: 1120 health, speed 88.5, missile salvos at range 700 for aircraft only, 350 sonar. It covers a hovercraft force or a fleet against light aircraft; against ground it does nothing and it is expensive for its role, so build only what the enemy's air warrants. It sails with Caymans (corsnap) and a Halberd (corhal), which do the fighting.

corak.name: Grunt
corak.air: 14 dps against aircraft (19% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
corak.gloss: cheap fast raider bot; kills builders, extractors and scouts, loses to Pawns, Thugs and light tanks
corak.prose: The Grunt is Cortex's tier-1 raider: 43 metal, 280 health, speed 81, a 37-damage laser every half second (74 a second) at range 215, with 520 sight. It is cheaper than the Pawn (armpw) and outranges it, and it is for what cannot shoot back: constructors, extractors, radar and lone turrets under construction. In equal-metal duels it loses to the Pawn slightly (less health), to the Thug (corthud), to light tanks that outpace and outlast it, and to any Sentry (armllt) or Guard (corllt); the guide's claim that Grunts beat Thugs head on is doubtful. Its laser costs no energy. A handful held beside the commander is the early guard; a Grunt ball at a defended line is metal lost.

coralab.name: Advanced Bot Lab
coralab.gloss: tier-2 bot factory, 2600 metal, 600 build power; the gate to tier 2 through bots
coralab.prose: The Advanced Bot Lab is the tier-2 bot factory: 2600 metal and 16000 energy, 4500 health, 600 build power, four times the tier-1 lab's, making the Advanced Construction Bot (corack), Twitcher, Fiend, Duck, Sumo, Mammoth, Termite, Sheldon, Arbiter, Manticore, Bedbug, Skuttle, Augur, Spectre, Commando and the Decoy Commander. A tier-1 constructor builds it, not the commander; with the first advanced constructor the entry costs about 3100 metal before any return, and at 26000 build time one constructor takes five minutes while the commander with two helpers takes under one. The rule of thumb is to start it at +30 metal and +500 energy a second, or +20 with 1000 to 1500 banked; earlier it idles the tier-1 army and loses to a tier-1 push. The opponent's medium setting has one by minute 20 in most games, never before 15.

coramph.name: Duck
coramph.air: 34 dps against aircraft (25% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
coramph.gloss: amphibious tier-2 bot with a torpedo and a laser; walks the sea floor to raid naval buildings; weak laser
coramph.prose: The Duck is a 330-metal amphibious bot (2350 health, speed 55) with a torpedo at range 400 for ships and a 150-damage laser at range 300 for land. It walks the sea floor into an enemy's naval economy and, in numbers, can turn a sea fight; on land its laser is weak and it loses to any line unit. It is a sea-map unit; on a land map there is no reason to build it.

coramsub.name: Amphibious Complex
coramsub.gloss: tier-1 amphibious factory built under water, 1200 metal; makes the Muskrat, Garpike, Salamander, Poison Arrow, Trasher, Manticore
coramsub.prose: The Amphibious Complex is a factory built on the sea floor: 1200 metal and 5600 energy, 2800 health, 300 build power, making the Muskrat (cormuskrat), Garpike, Salamander, Poison Arrow, Trasher and Manticore, units that walk under water and arrive from the sea. It is offered only where the builder reaches deep water; it is a sea-map choice and expensive for a tier-1 factory. Its units are the ones that come out of the water behind an enemy's shore defences, which is what it is for.

corantiship.name: Oasis
corantiship.gloss: tier-2 support ship: mobile anti-nuke, 300 energy, 2950 radar and sonar; a fleet's only nuke cover
corantiship.prose: The Oasis is the fleet's support ship: 1400 metal, 5000 health, speed 63, an anti-nuke stockpile (20 missiles, 90 seconds each), 300 energy a second, 2950 radar, 760 sonar and 1000 build power for assisting and repair. It is the only nuke protection a fleet can carry and makes a third of a fusion's energy for a third of the cost; keep one in every naval force. It has no gun.

corap.name: Aircraft Plant
corap.gloss: tier-1 aircraft plant, 630 metal; makes the air constructor, Finch, Valiant, Whirlwind, Shuriken, Hercules, Hephaestus; carries 510 radar
corap.prose: The Aircraft Plant is the tier-1 air factory: 630 metal and 1100 energy, 2150 health, 150 build power, with its own 510 radar, making the Construction Aircraft (corca), Finch scout, Valiant fighter, Whirlwind bomber, Shuriken stun drone and the Hercules and Hephaestus transports. It is the way to a scout that sees the whole map and to fighters when the enemy flies; its combat aircraft are fragile and die to the first anti-air, so it is a second factory, not a first. Its 150 build power makes an aircraft at the rate of a bot lab, and every unit it makes needs a lot of energy.

corape.name: Wasp
corape.gloss: tier-2 rocket gunship, 111 dps at 410; defends your own air space against light units; dies to flak
corape.prose: The Wasp is a rocket gunship: 370 metal, 1560 health, speed 159, rockets doing 111 damage a second at range 410. It kills clumps of light units and raider ships without anti-air cover and survives light tier-1 anti-air, but it is for area defence inside your own air cover, not assaulting a base: flak, fighters and heavy anti-air kill it. It has less armour than the Roughneck (armbrawl).

corarad.name: Advanced Radar Tower
corarad.gloss: 400-metal tier-2 radar tower, 3500 radar; sees most of a map
corarad.prose: The Advanced Radar Tower shows everything within 3500 as radar dots, for 400 metal and 14000 energy, 500 health. One covers most of a small map's approaches and feeds every long-range weapon; hills block it, jammers hide units from it and cloaked units do not show. Only the tier-2 constructors and the Twitcher (corfast) build it.

corarch.name: Arrow Storm
corarch.gloss: tier-2 anti-air ship, flak and missiles at 870; wipes waves of aircraft light and heavy; sails inside the fleet
corarch.prose: The Arrow Storm is the fleet's anti-air: 1000 metal, 3900 health, speed 60, flak at range 775 and missile turrets at 870 built for aircraft; its missiles do a little damage to ships but it is no warship. It wipes a wave of light aircraft and hurts heavy ones, and every fleet needs one once the enemy has air. Its missiles do a little damage to ships, but it is never the line; the Buccaneers (corcrus) are.

corason.name: Advanced Sonar Station
corason.gloss: 160-metal tier-2 sonar station under water, 1600 sonar; finds submarines and submerged commanders
corason.prose: The Advanced Sonar Station is built on the sea floor: 160 metal and 2400 energy, 2400 health, 1600 sonar. It finds submarines, amphibious units and a commander walking under water, which no radar sees; the Advanced Construction Sub (coracsub) builds it. It is cheap, and without it a fleet is blind to what swims beneath it.

corasy.name: Advanced Shipyard
corasy.gloss: tier-2 shipyard on water, 2800 metal; makes the Buccaneer, Predator, Kraken, Arrow Storm, Messenger, Despot, Black Hydra
corasy.prose: The Advanced Shipyard is the tier-2 naval factory, built only on water: 2800 metal and 10000 energy, 5900 health, 600 build power, making the Advanced Construction Sub (coracsub), Pathfinder, Buccaneer, Predator, Kraken, Arrow Storm, Phantasm, Oasis, Brimstone, Messenger, Despot and Black Hydra. It is offered only where the builder reaches deep water. Its 600 build power keeps up with a tier-2 sea economy; a Construction Ship (corcs) assisting doubles its output.

coratl.name: Lamprey
coratl.air: 363 dps against aircraft, its full damage
coratl.gloss: 1050-metal tier-2 torpedo launcher, 1100-damage homing torpedoes at 890; kills ships and subs; nothing against land or air
coratl.prose: The Lamprey is the tier-2 torpedo launcher on water: 1050 metal and 8500 energy, 2800 health, a 1100-damage homing torpedo every 3 seconds at range 890 with 400 sonar. It out-ranges tier-1 ships and kills submarines and raiders like the Brimstone (corfship); it cannot hit land or air. The Advanced Construction Sub (coracsub) builds it.

coravp.name: Advanced Vehicle Plant
coravp.gloss: tier-2 vehicle plant, 2600 metal, 600 build power; makes the advanced constructor vehicle, Tiger, Banisher, Tzar and the rest
coravp.prose: The Advanced Vehicle Plant is the tier-2 vehicle factory: 2600 metal and 16000 energy, 5100 health, 600 build power, making the Advanced Construction Vehicle (coracv), Salamander, Tiger, Poison Arrow, Tzar, Banisher, Quaker, Negotiator, Tremor, Fury, Saviour, Obscurer and Omen. A tier-1 constructor builds it; the entry costs and timing are the same as the advanced bot lab's (about 3100 metal, +30 metal and +500 energy a second), and it is the choice on flat open ground where heavy tanks and artillery pay. Its 600 build power and the heavy units it makes need an economy of +30 metal and +500 energy a second to keep it busy.

corawac.name: Condor
corawac.gloss: tier-2 radar and sonar plane, 2400 radar and 1200 sonar at speed 321; finds targets for bombers; unarmed
corawac.prose: The Condor is the flying radar: 180 metal, 990 health, speed 321, 2400 radar and 1200 sonar, no weapon. Several flown with the fighters give the front vision, one or two with a bombing run pick its targets, its sonar finds submarines and amphibious units, and radar shows a cloaked commander. Fighters kill it.

corban.name: Banisher
corban.air: 133 dps against aircraft, its full damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range
corban.gloss: tier-2 missile tank, 1000-damage homing missile at 800 every 7.5 s; kills most tier-2 in three hits
corban.prose: The Banisher fires a 1000-damage homing missile with a 128 splash every 7.5 seconds at range 800: 1000 metal, 2500 health, speed 54. It kills fast units that cannot dodge, Hounds (armfido) and Jaguars (armlatnk), most tier-2 threats in two or three hits, and it hits aircraft, though it prefers ground targets so it is unreliable as anti-air alone. It turns slowly and dies if caught; keep it behind Tigers (correap) with a side to the enemy so it can run, and use it as a first strike rather than a line.

corbats.name: Despot
corbats.gloss: 3400-metal battleship, plasma at 950 and a heavy laser; sinks ships and hits the shore; cannot target submarines
corbats.prose: The Despot is the tier-2 battleship: 3400 metal, 12000 health, speed 53, a 450-damage plasma cannon every 4 seconds at range 950 and a heavy laser at 700 (80 energy a shot), about 660 damage a second. It sinks ships with ease and hits land targets. It cannot target submerged units and takes heavy damage from battle submarines, so it sails with Predators (corshark) and an Arrow Storm (corarch).

corbhmth.name: Cerberus
corbhmth.gloss: 3100-metal geothermal plasma battery on a vent, 450 energy a second and three-shell salvos at 1650
corbhmth.prose: The Cerberus is a geothermal plant with a plasma battery on top, for a steam vent near the front: 3100 metal and 35000 energy, 8300 health, 450 energy a second, and three 450-damage shells every 4 seconds at range 1650 with a wide splash, for 150 energy a salvo. It denies the area around a contested vent and shells groups from beyond every tower's reach; it makes far less energy than a dedicated tier-2 geothermal, so it takes the risky vents and the Advanced Geothermal Powerplant (corageo) the safe ones. Only the tier-2 constructors build it.

corblackhy.name: Black Hydra
corblackhy.air: 353 dps against aircraft (27% of its ground damage)
corblackhy.gloss: 21000-metal flagship, plasma to 2550, lasers, anti-air; beats any tier-3 at range; no anti-submarine weapon
corblackhy.prose: The Black Hydra is the flagship: 21000 metal, 53000 health, speed 49.5, heavy plasma to range 2550, heavy lasers, anti-air. It beats any tier-3 unit that does not get close and bombards a coast from beyond reply; heavy aircraft and submarines kill it, since it has no anti-submarine weapon, so it never sails without submarine killers. Sail it broadside so every cannon and laser fires.

corbuzz.name: Calamity
corbuzz.gloss: 68000-metal rapid-fire long-range cannon, 2000 damage every 0.75 s at 6100; ends games, the enemy's whole attention
corbuzz.prose: The Calamity is the rapid-fire long-range cannon: 68000 metal and 800000 energy, 33500 health, a 2000-damage shell every 0.75 seconds at range 6100 for 18000 energy a shot. It is a whole late economy in one building and, running, it levels everything in range; it is also the first target of everything the enemy has. There is nothing in the harness that knows when it is the right buy.

corbw.name: Shuriken
corbw.gloss: 58-metal paralyser drone, stun beam at 220 for 7 s, no damage; ambushes off radar, dies to any anti-air
corbw.prose: The Shuriken is a light drone with a paralysing beam: 58 metal, 83 health, speed 280, range 220, stunning a target for seven seconds without damaging it and moving on to the next unstunned one. A group stuns a line or a cruiser for whatever follows to kill; it dies in one hit to any anti-air, so surprise is its whole strength, and amphibious tanks and spiders shrug off most of the stun. Hide it from radar until it strikes.

corca.name: Construction Aircraft
corca.gloss: tier-1 constructor aircraft, 55 build power at speed 131; expands anywhere, builds the advanced aircraft plant; fragile
corca.prose: The Construction Aircraft is the fastest builder: 115 metal, 161 health, speed 131, 55 build power, no weapon. It flies over terrain to claim far extractors and to reclaim, and its list is the tier-1 base plus the advanced aircraft plant (coraap), advanced solar and the heavy turrets; its build power is low, so use several on one job. Any anti-air or fighter kills it at once.

corcan.name: Sumo
corcan.air: 69 dps against aircraft (20% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
corcan.gloss: tier-2 armoured assault bot: 6000 health, 344 dps beam at 275, 45 energy a shot; the Cortex line unit
corcan.prose: The Sumo is the unit a Cortex tier-2 army is built on: 560 metal, 6000 health, speed 38, a beam laser doing 344 damage a second at range 275 for 45 energy a shot, about 56 energy a second at full rate. At 10.7 health a metal against the Thug's (corthud) 7.9 it soaks fire and kills what comes close; the simulated tier-2 study puts Sumos at half the army's metal with Thugs and Aggravators (corstorm) for the rest at +0.35 to +0.68 against the opponent's minute-20 army, where the tier-1 line alone scores about zero. It loses to being kited by longer range and to an energy stall, since its beam stops when energy is gone. Pair it with a Mammoth (corsumo) when a tower line has to be broken, not with Sheldons (cormort).

corcat.name: Catapult
corcat.gloss: 4900-metal rocket mech; 20 heavy rockets at 1350 every 15 s; smashes grouped units and turret lines
corcat.prose: The Catapult fires a barrage of twenty 450-damage rockets in a spread around the target at range 1350 every fifteen seconds: 4900 metal, 6100 health, speed 48. It outranges every turret and every other land unit, including the Vanguard (armvang), and it wrecks grouped units, turret lines and fleets near a shore. Between salvos it is helpless and it has little health, so it needs a screen and cover against raiders and air.

corch.name: Construction Hovercraft
corch.gloss: tier-1 constructor hovercraft, 115 build power; builds on land and water including naval buildings; unarmed
corch.prose: The Construction Hovercraft is a 190-metal amphibious constructor (1490 health, speed 61, 115 build power) with the largest build list of any tier-1 builder: the whole land base plus the naval buildings. It has more build power than the constructor bot or vehicle and crosses water, so it expands early onto islands and shores. It is unarmed.

corck.name: Construction Bot
corck.gloss: tier-1 constructor bot, 85 build power; builds the base, the advanced lab and turrets; unarmed
corck.prose: The Construction Bot is the ordinary tier-1 builder: 120 metal, 85 build power, speed 34.5, 820 health, no weapon. It builds everything the commander can plus the advanced bot lab (coralab), the heavy turrets and the geothermal plant, and it assists factories and repairs. It dies to any raider that finds it alone, so expand in steps the army already covers and do not walk it to a far spot unescorted. Two or three on one project add their build power.

corcom.name: Cortex Commander
corcom.air: 188 dps against aircraft, its full damage
corcom.gloss: the one unit you cannot lose; builds the base, D-guns anything at 262, laser at 300
corcom.prose: The Cortex Commander starts the game as your only unit and the game ends when it dies, so it is both your first builder and your last line. It has 300 build power (a tier-1 constructor has 85), makes 30 energy a second, stores 500 of each resource, and its build list is the whole tier-1 base: extractors, solar and wind, a bot lab, vehicle plant, aircraft plant or shipyard, the light turrets, radar, storage and converters. Its laser does 187 damage a second at range 300 and its D-gun kills any unit outright at range 262 for 500 energy a shot, so a small party of Pawns (armpw) or Grunts (corak) that reaches it dies; it still loses to a real army, to artillery it cannot reach, and to being far from home when the enemy comes. With 3700 health it is the toughest thing you own in the first ten minutes, which makes a commander standing beside its outposts the cheapest defence there is. It can cloak (100 energy a second standing, 1000 moving) and walk under water, and its death explosion levels everything around it.

corcrash.name: Trasher
corcrash.gloss: tier-1 anti-air bot; missiles at 760 only hurt aircraft, useless against ground; walks under water
corcrash.prose: The Trasher is the tier-1 mobile anti-air: 125 metal, 640 health, speed 53, missiles at range 760 that do full damage to aircraft and 1 point to anything else, so against ground it is nothing and a Grunt (corak) kills it. Build it only once enemy aircraft or an aircraft plant have been seen; two or three with the army stop gunships and bombers picking the line apart. It can walk under water but not fire from there.

corcrus.name: Buccaneer
corcrus.air: 45 dps against aircraft (11% of its ground damage)
corcrus.gloss: tier-2 cruiser, lasers at 500 and seeker torpedoes; the tier-2 fleet's staple, kills any tier-1 ship, no anti-air
corcrus.prose: The Buccaneer is the tier-2 cruiser: 1000 metal, 6200 health, speed 54, lasers doing 532 damage a second at range 500 (they need energy), seeker torpedoes for submarines and 375 sonar. It beats any tier-1 ship and hovercraft and is fast for tier 2, the staple of a tier-2 fleet. It is defenceless against aircraft; keep an Arrow Storm (corarch) or fighters over it.

corcrwh.name: Dragon
corcrwh.air: 95 dps against aircraft (15% of its ground damage)
corcrwh.gloss: 5100-metal flying fortress, lasers and flame at 450-575, anti-air missiles; kills massed ground and tier-3, dies to stealth fighters
corcrwh.prose: The Dragon is the flying fortress: 5100 metal, 16700 health, speed 115, beam lasers at 525 and 575 (30 energy a shot), a flamethrower at 450 and anti-air missiles at 840, about 630 damage a second on the ground. It hunts down heavy units and tier-3, burns massed ground forces and contests the air against gunships. Stealth fighters (Highwind armhawk, Nighthawk corvamp) kill it despite its own anti-air, so keep friendly anti-air near it.

corcs.name: Construction Ship
corcs.gloss: tier-1 constructor ship, 125 build power; builds naval and underwater buildings and the advanced shipyard; unarmed
corcs.prose: The Construction Ship is the sea builder: 200 metal, 1080 health, speed 60, 125 build power, no weapon. It claims underwater metal spots, builds the naval defences and economy, and the Advanced Shipyard (corasy) is on its list; one assisting a shipyard nearly doubles its output. Anything that shoots at ships kills it.

corcsa.name: Construction Seaplane
corcsa.gloss: tier-1 constructor seaplane, 75 build power at speed 140; builds land and naval buildings, repairs ships; unarmed
corcsa.prose: The Construction Seaplane is a 140-metal flying constructor (435 health, speed 140, 75 build power) that lands on water and can submerge. It builds the land base and the naval buildings and its speed makes it the repairer for ships at the front. Fighters kill it easily.

corcut.name: Cutlass
corcut.gloss: tier-1 seaplane gunship, twin cannons at 430; surprise raids on ships and naval bases; dies to anti-air
corcut.prose: The Cutlass is a light seaplane gunship: 230 metal, 1010 health, speed 152, twin cannons doing 72 damage a second at range 430 against land and sea units. A group makes fast surprise attacks on ships and naval buildings and gets through a light missile turret; naval anti-air, fighters and anything heavier kill it. Its 1010 health and speed 152 are what it has; scout the target's anti-air before the run.

corcv.name: Construction Vehicle
corcv.gloss: tier-1 constructor vehicle, 95 build power; builds the base and the advanced vehicle plant; slow uphill, unarmed
corcv.prose: The Construction Vehicle is the vehicle plant's builder: 145 metal, 1430 health, speed 51, 95 build power, no weapon. It has more health and build power than the constructor bot but cannot climb steep hills, so it expands on flat ground. Its list is the tier-1 base plus the advanced vehicle plant (coravp) and the heavy turrets; a pair expanding together heal each other and build a turret before a raider arrives. It dies to any raider that finds it alone.

cordecom.name: Commander
cordecom.air: 188 dps against aircraft, its full damage
cordecom.gloss: a look-alike commander with a weak D-gun and 300 build power; bait and front-line builder
cordecom.prose: The Decoy Commander looks like the real Cortex Commander to the enemy, with the same 3700 health and speed, but costs 750 metal, and its D-gun does only 40 damage a shot for 150 energy. Its use is to draw fire and D-gun shots meant for the real commander and to bring 300 build power to the front, where it builds the tier-1 basics, walls and mines. It cannot win a fight against an army and dies to anything the real commander would; it comes from the advanced bot lab (coralab) once the enemy has shown it will hunt commanders. Like the real one it can cloak and walk under water.

cordemon.name: Demon
cordemon.air: 250 dps against aircraft (17% of its ground damage)
cordemon.gloss: 6000-metal fast flamethrower mech, 500 range; lays waste to massed units; no EMP resistance
cordemon.prose: The Demon is a fast tier-3 assault mech: 6000 metal, 18000 health, speed 63, a flamethrower at range 500 doing over 1600 damage a second across a cone, plus an anti-air missile launcher. It spearheads an assault and burns massed units; it has no paralyse resistance, so spy bots (armspy), the Stiletto EMP bomber (armstil) and Webbers (armspid) stop it cold. Its speed for its size is what makes it dangerous: it reaches a line before the line can reposition, and it needs an anti-EMP escort rather than more armour.

cordl.name: Jellyfish
cordl.air: 150 dps against aircraft, its full damage
cordl.gloss: 250-metal coastal torpedo launcher on land, 150 dps at 600 with sonar; guards shore buildings from ships and subs
cordl.prose: The Jellyfish is the coastal torpedo launcher, built on the shore: 250 metal and 2200 energy, 2350 health, a 225-damage torpedo every 1.5 seconds at range 600 and 600 sonar, immune to torpedoes itself. It defends shoreline buildings against ships and submarines and cannot hit land, air or hovercraft. The commander can build it.

cordoom.name: Bulwark
cordoom.air: 422 dps against aircraft (28% of its ground damage)
cordoom.gloss: 3000-metal three-laser tower, 4500 damage at 950 plus two shorter lasers, 9400 health; retracts when off; hungry for energy
cordoom.prose: The Bulwark is the heavy multi-laser tower: 3000 metal and 37000 energy, 9400 health, a 4500-damage beam every 6 seconds at range 950 (800 energy a shot), a 247-damage beam at 650 twice a second (50 energy) and a short rapid laser, about 1500 damage a second together. Its main gun out-ranges Mausers (armmart) and Sharpshooters (armsnipe) and its three guns kill swarms and heavies at once; it is the focal point of a base's defence, funnelled into by walls. Energy is its weakness: firing it drains a fusion, and in a stall it is a wall. Switched off it retracts into a shell with nearly four times the health.

cordrag.name: Dragon's Teeth
cordrag.gloss: 8-metal wall block with 2800 health; funnels tier-1 units and stops low shots; tier-2 tanks roll over it
cordrag.prose: The Dragon's Teeth is an 8-metal wall block with 2800 health. A line of them blocks most tier-1 units and low projectiles, funnels a push into a Pounder's (corlevlr) or a tower's fire, and keeps spy bots out of a base; heavy tier-2 tanks crush it. Enemies do not target it automatically, so it is reclaimed or shot by hand. It costs nothing worth counting.

corenaa.name: Naval Birdshot
corenaa.gloss: the tier-2 flak gun on water, 850 metal, wide bursts at 850 against aircraft
corenaa.prose: The Naval Birdshot is the Birdshot (corflak) built on water: 850 metal and 14000 energy, 1840 health, flak at range 850 that shatters groups of aircraft over a naval base. It does nothing against ships or ground. It is the naval base's answer to massed bombers once they have been seen.

corerad.name: Eradicator
corerad.gloss: 800-metal medium-range anti-air battery, four-missile bursts at 1200, 4450 health; the tower that kills most aircraft
corerad.prose: The Eradicator is the heavy tier-1 anti-air battery: 800 metal and 7900 energy, 4450 health, four-missile bursts at range 1200 for aircraft only. It has the most health, range and damage of the Cortex tier-1 anti-air towers and takes down most aircraft, the Liche (armliche) included, so it goes on the front line to hedge out enemy air; it does nothing against ground. It is the anti-air to build once the enemy has shown bombers or gunships rather than scouts; earlier the Thistle (corrl) does.

corestor.name: Energy Storage
corestor.gloss: 6000 energy storage for 175 metal; smooths wind and lets laser turrets fire through a lull; explodes when killed
corestor.prose: The Energy Storage adds 6000 energy storage for 175 metal and 1800 energy, 2000 health. Storage is what lets a wind economy ride out a lull and what keeps laser turrets and beam weapons firing: a tower line fires at the rate energy arrives once the store is empty. It explodes with a large blast when destroyed and a larger one on self-destruct, so it stands away from the base, or on an approach as a deliberate trap.

coresupp.name: Supporter
coresupp.air: 13 dps against aircraft (15% of its ground damage)
coresupp.gloss: tier-1 fast gun boat, speed 110, 91 dps lasers at 280; kills constructors, swarms heavier ships from the sides
coresupp.prose: The Supporter is the fast light gun boat: 100 metal, 480 health, speed 110, two beam lasers doing 91 damage a second at range 280. It kills expanding constructors early and swarms a heavier ship from several sides; its turrets cannot fire over each other, so it fights broadside. It is more accurate and hits less hard than the Dolphin (armdecade); torpedo launchers and destroyers kill it at range.

coreter.name: Obscurer
coreter.gloss: radar jammer vehicle, hides units within 450 from enemy radar for 80 energy a second; unarmed
coreter.prose: The Obscurer is a 105-metal jammer vehicle: everything within 450 of it is hidden from enemy radar, for 80 energy a second, and a hit on it drops the field for a moment. It goes with an army against radar-guided artillery and ranged units, which cannot shoot what they cannot detect; a Tracer (armsd) or Nemesis (corsd) sees through it. It has 580 health and no weapon.

corexp.name: Exploiter
corexp.air: 11 dps against aircraft (7% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
corexp.gloss: 240-metal armed extractor with a Guard's laser at 435, 1440 health; holds a front-line spot against a few raiders
corexp.prose: The Exploiter is a metal extractor with a light laser tower on top: 240 metal and 1900 energy, 1440 health, the yield of a Metal Extractor (cormex), a 75-damage beam every half second at range 435 for 15 energy a shot. It holds a front-line spot against a scout or a couple of Grunts (corak) on its own, and Dragon's Teeth (cordrag) beside it make it a small outpost; more than a handful of bots, artillery or rockets that out-range it kill it, and it stops extracting while it fires. Only a tier-1 constructor builds it, not the commander, and it costs nearly five plain extractors.

coreyes.name: Beholder
coreyes.gloss: 32-metal cloaked camera with 540 sight, buildable on cliffs; a picket line that catches cloaked movement
coreyes.prose: The Beholder is a tiny cloaked observation post: 32 metal and 850 energy, 280 health, 540 sight, invisible to radar, cloaked for 15 energy a second, buildable almost anywhere including steep cliffs. Staggered lines of them across a gap watch what jammers hide and catch a cloaked unit walking through, since sight sees what radar cannot; it cannot itself see cloaked units, and a Juno (corjuno) pulse kills it outright. It draws 5 energy a second uncloaked and 15 cloaked, so a picket line is a small standing cost.

corfast.name: Twitcher
corfast.gloss: fast tier-2 combat engineer, 150 build power at speed 90; builds tier-1 basics, mines and walls; unarmed
corfast.prose: The Twitcher is a fast builder: 210 metal, 830 health, speed 90, 150 build power, with a tier-1 build list plus mines and walls. It gets build power to a forward lab, a repair or a minefield quickly, and can lay down a Bot Lab (corlab) at the front and help it. It has no weapon and dies to anything that catches it; build it when build power at the front, not metal, is what is missing.

corfatf.name: Naval Pinpointer
corfatf.gloss: the targeting facility built on water, 800 metal, 150 energy a second
corfatf.prose: The Naval Pinpointer is the Pinpointer (cortarg) built on water: 800 metal and 7500 energy, 1530 health, halving radar-dot wobble for the whole team for 150 energy a second, stacking with diminishing returns. The Advanced Construction Sub (coracsub) builds it. It is a late buy for a fleet with long-range guns to guide.

corfav.name: Rascal
corfav.air: 2 dps against aircraft (6% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
corfav.gloss: 26-metal scout car, the fastest land unit; finds the enemy and kills bare extractors; any hit kills it
corfav.prose: The Rascal is the vehicle plant's scout: 26 metal, 90 health, speed 153, sight 600, a 35-damage laser at range 180. It finds the enemy's expansion and kills extractors and constructors nobody guards, and a stream of them at the front draws fire from snipers and artillery that cannot track it. Any turret or armed unit kills it; it cannot hit aircraft.

corfdoom.name: Devastator
corfdoom.air: 352 dps against aircraft (48% of its ground damage)
corfdoom.gloss: 1200-metal floating multi-weapon platform, plasma at 900 and two lasers, 6700 health; helpless against air
corfdoom.prose: The Devastator is the tier-2 floating defence platform: 1200 metal and 15000 energy, 6700 health, a 420-damage plasma cannon every 2.1 seconds at range 900, a 231-damage laser at 630 (45 energy a shot) and a short rapid laser, about 730 damage a second together with guns that track independently. It is the focal point of a naval base's defence against surface ships and hovercraft; it is helpless against aircraft and needs anti-air beside it. The Advanced Construction Sub (coracsub) builds it.

corfdrag.name: Shark's Teeth
corfdrag.gloss: 15-metal naval wall block with 4450 health; funnels tier-1 ships and blocks low shots
corfdrag.prose: The Shark's Teeth is a 15-metal wall block on water with 4450 health. A line blocks most tier-1 ships and low projectiles, funnels a fleet into a torpedo launcher's fire and shields floating towers; heavier ships and aircraft ignore it. It costs nothing worth counting and takes a beating before it breaks.

corfhlt.name: Coral
corfhlt.air: 52 dps against aircraft (23% of its ground damage, and only when nothing on the ground is in range)
corfhlt.gloss: 480-metal floating heavy laser tower, 231 dps at 630, 45 energy a shot; kills light ships, useless against subs
corfhlt.prose: The Coral is the heavy laser tower built on water: 480 metal and 6200 energy, 4350 health, a 231-damage beam every second at range 630, 45 energy a shot. It kills corvettes, frigates and hovertanks with more punch than the land Warden (corhlt); it cannot hit submarines and alone it is a target, so it stands with torpedo launchers. It stops in an energy stall.

corfhp.name: Naval Hovercraft Platform
corfhp.gloss: tier-1 hovercraft platform on water, 670 metal; the same hovercraft as the land platform
corfhp.prose: The Naval Hovercraft Platform is the water-built version of the Hovercraft Platform (corhp): 670 metal and 2000 energy, 3750 health, 150 build power, the same six hovercraft. It is offered only where the builder finds water deep enough; build it when the land platform's site is not safe or not there. It makes the same units at the same rate and costs the same; only the site differs.

corfink.name: Finch
corfink.gloss: 51-metal air scout, speed 360, sight 835; sees the enemy base and army; unarmed, dies to fighters
corfink.prose: The Finch is the air scout: 51 metal, 100 health, speed 360, sight 835 and 1120 radar, no weapon. A pass over the enemy base shows its factories, economy and army in seconds; a stream of them late in a game keeps artillery accurate and draws anti-air fire away from bombers. Fighters and any anti-air kill it. Build one as soon as the aircraft plant stands and another whenever the picture is stale.

corflak.name: Birdshot
corflak.gloss: 850-metal tier-2 flak gun at 850; wide bursts shatter groups of aircraft; nothing against ground
corflak.prose: The Birdshot is the tier-2 flak gun: 850 metal and 14000 energy, 1840 health, rapid flak at range 850 whose wide bursts devastate most aircraft in a formation. It is the answer to massed bombers and gunships around a base or on a front; missile anti-air reaches further and flak kills groups. Only the tier-2 constructors and the Twitcher (corfast) build it, and it does nothing against ground.

corfmd.name: Prevailer
corfmd.gloss: 1500-metal anti-nuke, stockpiled interceptors cover a 2000 radius; the only answer to a nuclear silo
corfmd.prose: The Prevailer is the fixed anti-nuke: 1500 metal and 40000 energy, 3300 health, intercepting nuclear missiles aimed within 2000 of it with stockpiled interceptors, each 150 metal and 7500 energy and 90 seconds, up to 20. It is the only answer to an Armageddon (armsilo) or Apocalypse (corsilo), and it must have a missile ready when the nuke comes; lower the stockpile limit so it stops eating resources once a few are stored. A cloaked spy's EMP burst disables it for twenty seconds, so a Nemesis (corsd) stands near it.

corfmine3.name: Heavy Mine
corfmine3.gloss: 32-metal cloaked naval mine; blows up an unsuspecting ship and everything near it
corfmine3.prose: The naval Heavy Mine is a 32-metal cloaked mine on water (4 energy a second) that explodes on contact with a ship and damages everything in a wide area. A field of them laid by a Pathfinder (cormls) holds hovercraft and light ships off an area; keep your own ships off it. It is cloaked, so an enemy without sonar or a minesweeper finds it by hitting it.

corfmkr.name: Naval Energy Converter
corfmkr.gloss: the energy converter on water, 70 energy a second into 1 metal; for maps with little land
corfmkr.prose: The Naval Energy Converter is the Energy Converter (cormakr) built on water: 70 energy a second into 1 metal a second for 1 metal and 1250 energy, 167 health. It is for a surplus of energy on a sea base; it chains explosions when clustered. Extractors and tidal generators beat it while spots and tide remain, as on land.

corfort.name: Fortification Wall
